title: Published runtime
notes: `41a8fdf` with a DMARC/SPF search headline, public metadata,
WebApplication structured data, protocol guides, visible questions and a
valid public sitemap. Reports show the score and prioritized next step
first, keep the last valid report on retry failure and offer a copyable

result: The public site is live, its prior runtime is preserved, and private routes remain blocked. The README describes the current email observability product and uses current dashboard, domain, sending-source and diagnostics screenshots with synthetic data. Competitor evidence and future feature boundaries are in `docs/checker-competitive-review.md`; the product backlog includes blocklist monitoring, real-message checks, transport health, header analysis and related tools.
evidence: `pnpm run check:ci` passed (193 test files, 1,010 tests), followed by focused navigation tests for the initial loading-state change. The Linux standalone build passed. `PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 scripts/check-public-website.py https://insight.vexamail.com teleporte.es` passed. Browser verification against production passed domain navigation, one request per submission, invalid retry preservation, successful retry, Back/Forward, share feedback and phone overflow checks. Desktop/phone captures were reviewed in both themes; remaining automated warnings describe zero-duration transitions and an intentional readable paragraph width. A stricter robots-sitemap assertion later found stale CDN responses on some nodes. An owner-approved, one-hour temporary token purged only the public robots, sitemap and dashboard-preview URLs; token revocation was verified against the token inventory. The first immediate purge attempt returned 401; a fresh temporary token succeeded after a short propagation delay. Both temporary tokens were revoked. The stricter public verification command above then passed, including the robots sitemap declaration; the preview returned HTTP 200. Search Console indexing and rankings remain unverified.
